valid_coordinates.name: valid_coordinates
valid_coordinates.value: ("communities"."latitude" is null and "communities"."longitude" is null) or ("communities"."latitude" is not null and "communities"."longitude" is not null and "communities"."latitude" between -90 and 90 and "communities"."longitude" between -180 and 180)

contact_authorizations_evidence.name: contact_authorizations_evidence
contact_authorizations_evidence.value: (not "contact_authorizations"."allow_whatsapp" and not "contact_authorizations"."allow_sms" and not "contact_authorizations"."allow_calls") or ("contact_authorizations"."communication_evidence" is not null and length(trim("contact_authorizations"."communication_evidence")) between 1 and 1000)

demands_description.name: demands_description
demands_description.value: "demands"."description" is null or length(trim("demands"."description")) between 1 and 3000

demands_resolution_length.name: demands_resolution_length
demands_resolution_length.value: "demands"."resolution" is null or length(trim("demands"."resolution")) between 1 and 2000

demands_closure.name: demands_closure
demands_closure.value: ("demands"."status" in ('em_andamento','aguardando_retorno') and "demands"."closed_at" is null and "demands"."resolution" is null) or ("demands"."status" in ('concluida','cancelada') and "demands"."closed_at" is not null and "demands"."resolution" is not null)

election_place_identifiers.name: election_place_identifiers
election_place_identifiers.value: "election_places"."year" between 1994 and 2100 and "election_places"."zone" between 1 and 9999 and "election_places"."uf" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$' and "election_places"."municipality" ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,6}$' and "election_places"."place" ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,7}$'

election_result_numbers.name: election_result_numbers
election_result_numbers.value: "election_results"."year" between 1994 and 2100 and "election_results"."turn" in (1,2) and "election_results"."zone" between 1 and 9999 and "election_results"."section" between 1 and 99999 and "election_results"."votes" between 0 and 1000000
